source_mode: Two fixed, previously measured palm anchors plus one bounded sequential fit per long finger; original licensed mesh and rig preserved
requirements: Do not rerun or alter any sealed packet; use recorded calibrationLeft from x-10-z0 and x-20-z-10 only
Use original long-finger angles and splay from hand-wrap calibration-start, preserving its corrected thumb, body and right-hand commands
Per fixed anchor, four long fingers each get one search of at most400 evaluations; MCP20..65, PIP10..70, DIP0.25..0.75PIP capped45, original splay plus/minus12 degrees
No splay-domain drift relative to previous fitted poses; no adaptive anchors, new seed retries or second coordinate passes
Fixed weapon, right hand, left palm/wrist/forearm and thumb within each fit; source geometry, local positions/scales and parentage preserved
Each long finger needs at least two reviewed phalange patches with3 unique vertices and2 faces within1.5mm, opposing normals and nearest signed distance at least-0.25mm
All final visible hand/gun, left inter-finger, arm/gun, torso/gun and left forearm/torso transverse crossings must be zero, and fixed transforms must hold
Reload final serialized calibration and reproduce pose, contact counts and collision metrics; perform independent natural-grip visual review
Passing this subset does not settle thumb patch review, right pinky support, containment/coplanarity, death release/drop or runtime performance; no automatic runtime promotion
If both predetermined anchors fail, preserve evidence and stop this parameterization before considering wrist orientation as a new structural variable
